configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.displayName: Ninja + clang + x64 Release (the only supported config)
configurePresets.description: Pins the generator/arch/compiler. Without this, a default `cmake -S . -B build` (e.g. an IDE's background configure) picks the Visual Studio generator with platform win32, which clobbers the cache and then fails with 'SDL3 ... version not compatible' because vcpkg only has x64-windows. Recover with: cmake --preset default

configurePresets.name: player
configurePresets.displayName: Player build: the default config + ThinLTO (build-player/)
configurePresets.description: What tools/player/make_player_build.ps1 packages. Same pins as 'default' plus SR_THINLTO=ON (PERFORMANCE 2.18); its own build dir so the default build's cache and objects are untouched.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.displayName: Release build: the C1 release composition (build-release/)
configurePresets.description: What ships (docs/RELEASE_COMPOSITION.md, ledger release.composition): the default config with SR_RELEASE_COMPOSITION=ON, so SupermanReturns is compiled with SR_ORACLE=0 and the emulation / development-oracle units are excluded, not disabled. Packaged by tools/player/make_player_build.ps1 -Release; audited by tools/player/composition_audit.py (the worker: tools/cloud/sr_cloud.py build --define SR_RELEASE_COMPOSITION=ON). ThinLTO is not part of the audited release configuration.
